name: Texas Hold'em
summary: Blinds, hole cards, and betting with call, raise, and all-in against side-pot-aware chips.

name: Blackjack
summary: Hit or stand against the dealer, with live soft totals and automatic bust detection.

name: War
summary: Both sides flip at once; the higher card sweeps the pile into a capture stack.

name: Go Fish
summary: Ask a rival for the rank you picked, go fishing when they have none, and bank books of four.

name: Crazy Eights
summary: Match the top card by suit or rank, play 8s as wildcards, and be the first to clear your hand.

name: Euchre
summary: Fast-paced 4-player trick-taking game played in partnerships with trump suits.

name: Gin Rummy
summary: Build melds of sets and runs, draw from stock or discard, and knock to catch your opponent.

name: Bullshit (I Doubt It)
summary: Play cards face-down into a pile while declaring ranks. Call Bullshit if you spot a lie!
